tasks.build:deps:lingui: deno task build:deps:lingui:macro && deno task build:deps:lingui:extract
tasks.build:deps: deno task build:deps:stoat-js && deno task build:deps:livekit && deno task build:deps:lingui && deno task lingui:compile
tasks.lingui: deno task lingui:extract && deno task lingui:compile
tasks.lingui:extract: cd packages/client && deno run -A npm:@lingui/cli extract
tasks.lingui:compile: cd packages/client && deno run -A npm:@lingui/cli compile --typescript
tasks.lingui:check: deno task lingui && git status --porcelain -- packages/client/components/i18n/catalogs | { ! grep -q .; }
tasks.lingui:pr: git checkout main -- packages/client/components/i18n/catalogs && deno task lingui:extract
tasks.build: deno task install:assets && deno task lingui:compile && cd packages/client && deno run -A npm:@pandacss/dev codegen && deno run -A npm:vite build
tasks.dev: deno task install:assets && cd packages/client && deno run -A npm:@pandacss/dev codegen && deno run -A npm:vite --host
tasks.start: cd packages/client && deno run -A npm:vite preview --host
tasks.test:e2e: cd packages/client && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test test
tasks.test:e2e:install-deps: cd packages/client && deno run -A npm:playwright install --with-deps
tasks.test:e2e:show-report: cd packages/client && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test show-report
